seo.title: About Clearline Pest Solutions
seo.description: A licensed, family-owned pest control company that inspects before it treats and documents every visit. Serving the Phoenix valley since 2011.

sections.heading: The people behind the field report.
sections.body: Clearline Pest Solutions is a Phoenix pest control company built on one idea: you should be able to see what you are paying for. The technician who inspects your home is the one who treats it, writes it up and comes back if anything gets through.

sections.label: Our story
sections.note: The company narrative goes here — who started Clearline Pest Solutions, why, and what has stayed the same since 2011. Aim for two or three short paragraphs, ideally with a photo of the team or a service truck.

sections.heading: What is on.

sections.heading: Know your enemy.
sections.intro: Five families of pest, one method: inspect, treat at the source, document.

cards.title: General pests
cards.body: Ants, roaches, spiders and crickets. Baited at the source, sealed out at the door.

cards.title: Scorpions
cards.body: UV night hunts, exclusion sealing and a perimeter they will not cross.

cards.title: Termites
cards.body: Licensed inspections, liquid barriers and bait systems with a renewable warranty.

cards.title: Rodents
cards.body: Roof rats and mice trapped out and sealed out with steel. Guaranteed.

cards.title: Biters & stingers
cards.body: Mosquitoes, wasps, fleas, ticks and bed bugs. Fast removal, safe yard.

sections.heading: Questions, answered.
sections.intro: If yours is not here, call the office. Nobody is reading from a script.

items.question: Are your treatments safe for kids and pets?
items.answer: Yes. We use targeted baits and low-toxicity products placed where pests live, not where people and pets do. Most treated areas are fine to use again once dry, usually within **30 minutes**.

items.question: Do I have to sign a contract?
items.answer: No. One-time treatments are available, and protection plans can be cancelled any time without a fee.

items.question: What is a field report?
items.answer: A written summary we leave after every visit: what we found, where we treated, what we sealed, and what to watch for, with photos. It is how you know the work was actually done.

items.question: What if pests come back between visits?
items.answer: Call us and we come back free. Every protection plan includes unlimited re-treats between scheduled visits.

items.question: Do I need to be home?
items.answer: For the first inspection, yes. For exterior-only follow-up visits, no — we text when we arrive and leave the field report by email.
